title: 第7章 无念皆是福第8章 无法期待徒增念想
lines: 地上的东西乱七八糟的，也有很多瓶瓶罐罐，更多的还是些什么书籍之类的，还有些像是内衣一般的玩意。
突然我看到地上那亮晶晶的石头。
现在的我睡眠充足，精神饱满，而且毫无疲惫，肚子也不饿，所以我也没有开口问这年轻人带吃的没有。
但是地上的那几颗亮晶晶的石头却是让我有些惊讶。
走下平台，我来到了广场，弯腰捡起了地上那泛着绿光的石头。
这玩意很像我在电视里面看到的宝石啊！
而且这种石头纯净度甚至更高，握在手里都令人暖暖的。
还不等我开口，一股奇香又顺着微风飘来。
那是酒香，一种我从来没有闻到过的酒香，虽然我也没有喝过什么好酒，但是老头却是个酒鬼，整天嘴里念叨着各种酒的味道，各种酒的好处，我耳濡目染也对酒有些了解，但是这次闻到酒的品质却是我前所未闻的！
“什么味道？”
我忍不住开口问道。
一旁的年轻人顿时打了个激灵。
“那个阁.阁主，是我先前不小心把我自己酿的劣制酒弄洒了，玷污了阁主的嗅觉，实在抱歉。”
我不由的惊讶的上下打量起眼前的年轻人，这家伙看起来跟自己年龄相仿，没想到居然能酿出如此美酒？
“能给我看看吗？”
我开口问道。
他没有说话，只是赶忙递给我一个红色的葫芦。
“那个阁主，弟子修为低下，用不起高级的盛具，只能用这最普通的葫芦了，里面也只有三缸劣水而已。”
年轻人有些不好意思的说道。
但是这话落在我耳边却是惊雷。
啥？这红葫芦居然能装三大缸酒？真的假的？有些不敢置信的看着年轻人。
“你说的都是真的？”
年轻人听到我说的话，连忙点头。
“弟子句句属实，不敢隐瞒，还望阁主恕罪。”
我有些汗颜，到现在这年轻人还如此有礼貌，这红葫芦里的酒和地上的绿色石头都是我想要的，但是换人家两样，也不知道人家愿不愿意？
我试探的从怀里掏出那被咬了一口的黄瓜。
“我用这黄瓜...不，翠果来换你的红葫芦里的酒和那几个石头，行吗？”
听到我的话后，眼前这年轻人直直的愣住了。
不，准确的来说，在我拿出黄瓜以后，那年轻人就愣住了，跟之前那紫袍老头一样，全部被这黄瓜勾去了魂。
但是我有些担心的，毕竟这里是大荒之地，先前跟人家要吃的人家都吐血了，这次又要喝的，这年轻人会不会也会吐血？
无念从来没有感觉自己的心跳跳的如此快过，快的甚至都仿佛跳出嗓子眼了！
眼前的珍宝阁阁主在自己面前掏出了那九品神果的翠果！
这原来就是九品神果啊！
无念还是第一次见过，自己甚至都闻到了这神果散发出那浓厚的灵气了！
以至于太过激动，甚至都没有听清楚珍宝阁主后来说的话。
content_en:
The things on the ground were messy, and there were many bottles and cans, and more of them were books and the like, and some things that looked like underwear.
Suddenly I saw the shiny stone on the ground.
Now I had enough sleep, full of energy, no fatigue, and not hungry, so I didn't ask the young man if he had brought anything to eat.
But the few shiny stones on the ground surprised me.
After walking off the platform, I came to the square, bent down and picked up the green stone on the ground.
This thing looks like the gem I saw on TV!
Moreover, the purity of this stone is even higher, and it feels warm when you hold it in your hand.
Before I could say anything, a strange fragrance floated in the breeze.
It was the aroma of wine, a kind of wine aroma that I had never smelled before. Although I had never drunk any good wine, the old man was an alcoholic. He talked about the taste of various wines and the benefits of various wines all day long. I had some knowledge of wine through my ears and eyes, but the quality of the wine I smelled this time was something I had never heard before!
"What does it smell like?"
I couldn't help but ask.
The young man on the side suddenly trembled.
"That Pavilion Master, I accidentally spilled the bad wine I brewed earlier, which tarnished the Pavilion Master's sense of smell. I'm really sorry."
I couldn't help but look up and down at the young man in front of me in surprise. This guy looked to be about the same age as me. I didn't expect that he could make such a fine wine?
"Can you show it to me?"
I asked.
He didn't say anything, but hurriedly handed me a red gourd.
"That pavilion master, his disciples are of low cultivation and cannot afford high-end utensils, so they can only use this common gourd, which contains only three tanks of bad water."
The young man said with some embarrassment.
But these words struck my ears like thunder.
What? This red gourd can actually hold three large vats of wine? Real or fake? Some looked at the young man in disbelief.
"Is everything you said true?"
The young man heard what I said and nodded quickly.
"Everything I say is true, I dare not hide it. I hope the master of the pavilion will forgive me."
I'm a little ashamed that this young man is still so polite. The wine in the red gourd and the green stones on the ground are both what I want, but I don't know if he would be willing to exchange them for the two.
I tentatively took out the bitten cucumber from my arms.
"I'll trade this cucumber...no, green fruit for the wine in your red gourd and those few stones, okay?"
After hearing my words, the young man in front of me was stunned.
No, to be precise, after I took out the cucumber, the young man was stunned. Just like the old man in purple robe before, he was completely distracted by the cucumber.
But I'm a little worried. After all, this is a deserted land. The people who asked for food before all vomited blood. Now they want to drink again. Will this young man also vomit blood?
Wu Nian has never felt his heart beat so fast, so fast that it even seems to jump out of his throat!
The master of the Treasure Pavilion in front of him took out the green fruit of the ninth-grade divine fruit in front of him!
This turns out to be the ninth-grade divine fruit!
This was the first time Wu Nian had seen it, and he could even smell the strong aura emanating from this divine fruit!
He was so excited that he didn't even hear clearly what the Treasure Pavilion Master said later.
title_en: Chapter 7 No thought is a blessing Chapter 8 Unable to expect more thoughts
